# Introduction

This book contains a collection of vignettes that guide users through different ways to access data on the AnVIL platform. 

## Motivation

One of the most common questions people have when they switch to using the AnVIL platform is "how do I get data onto it?" We created this book to provide small, step-by-step examples for users to try so that they can feel confident when moving data for their own research onto AnVIL. Each vignette is quick and designed to take ~15 minutes.

## Target Audience  

The course is intended for new and experienced users of the AnVIL platform. In order to follow the vignettes, **you must have an AnVIL account that is connected to a billing project.** Each vignette will incur only minimal costs.

These vignettes are built around common tasks that an individual user might do, as opposed to a user who is part of a consortium. Consortium members should consult their consortium for instructions on how to access that data.

## Curriculum  

We cover the following topics:

1. Bringing your own data onto AnVIL (including data stored locally, in the cloud, or on an HPC)
1. Importing data from common NIH data repositories like SRA
1. Finding data stored on AnVIL (including both open access and controlled access data)
